name: Trapped Terrors
source:
Two girls out on a trip are met with sudden rain and take shelter in a creepy abandoned hospital. With monsters that roam the hospital, a deranged doctor, and a mysterious little girl… what is the enigma hidden in that hospital? And will the two be able to escape to safety?

[Edited from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.gsheisa&hl=en_US&gl=US]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
两个外出旅行的女孩遭遇突如其来的大雨，她们在一家令人毛骨悚然的废弃医院避难。医院里横行的怪物、精神错乱的医生、神秘的小女孩……医院里到底隐藏着什么谜团？两人能否顺利逃生呢？

[编辑自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.gsheisa&hl=en_US&gl=US]Google Play[/url]]
